subject: Request: temporary overnight support bridge & P1/P2 response exception
messages:
From: James Carter <james@clearstream.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T21:21:00-05:00
Subject: Overnight coverage request ahead of data-migration

Vanessa,

We have a scheduled data center migration over the weekend (Dec 4-5) that will push additional traffic spikes into your hosted region (us-west-2) and temporarily increase our P1 surface for a 12-18 hour window overnight. Our security team is asking for confirmation on Redwood's on-call plan during that window and whether we can request a temporary P1 response SLA carve-out (i.e., agreed bridge with a 60-minute response for P1s for that window) to account for coordinated throttling and mitigation steps.

We want to avoid any disruption, but the migration is dependent on having predictable support. Can you confirm steps and a contact for the on-call bridge?

Thanks,
James Carter
Head of Ops 
ClearStream Logistics
attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: James Carter <james@clearstream.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T22:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Overnight coverage request ahead of data-migration

Hi James — thanks for the heads up and the context. We can do a temporary operational bridge for Dec 4-5, but we need to lock a few items before we commit to a modified P1 response window. Proposed plan: 

- Redwood will stand up a dedicated incident bridge (Zoom) and a single point-of-contact on-call engineer for the window 22:00 - 10:00 PST on Dec 4-5.
- For that window we propose a temporary SLA of 60-minute initial response for P1s and 3 hours for P2s.
- We will enable elevated tracing and prefix caching for your model routes for the window.
- Redwood requires an executed mutual action plan (MAP) and a one-time operational coordination call between our SRE and your migration leads.

Ben, Laura — tagging you for technical and approval steps. I’ll prepare a short MAP and runbook.

James — can you confirm the migration ETA and the list of endpoints/routes that will see increased traffic? If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute prep call tomorrow.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, James Carter <james@clearstream.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Overnight coverage request ahead of data-migration

James / Vanessa — adding technical detail and a draft runbook. Quick notes: 

1) Risk window: based on their migration description we expect the highest QPS delta between 23:00-03:00 PST.
2) Actionable playbook (summary):
   - 00:00 hour: enable strict routing to dedicated capacity pool for ClearStream model routes.
   - 00:30: if latency > 1.2s p50 for 3 min, escalate to on-call (P1) and open bridge.
   - 01:00: if sustained p95>2.5s, trigger throttle policy + fallback model variant.

I uploaded a short runbook and MAP to the shared Drive and attached a one-page MAP to this thread (CLEARSTREAM_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx) and the proposed runbook (overnight-bridge-runbook.md).

We will assign an on-call engineer (Ben C. from SRE on standby) and have a second-level (engineering) backup from Laura. Vanessa — if this is acceptable, Laura can approve the exception and Vivek signs the final client note for credits/SLAs.

ben
Ben Carter
SRE - Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
attachments: CLEARSTREAM_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx, overnight-bridge-runbook.md
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, James Carter <james@clearstream.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Overnight coverage request ahead of data-migration

Vanessa / Ben / James — I reviewed the MAP and runbook. Operationally this is reasonable for a one-off window provided the customer accepts the temporary response windows you proposed and we capture the fallback model/traffic limits in the MAP.

Vivek — requesting approval for a temporary SLA carve-out (60m P1 / 3h P2 for the Dec 4-5 window) and a one-time credit in the event of an outage attributable to migration coordination. Proposed credit: 5% pro-rated for the billing month if an incident meets the P1 outage criteria.

James — if you’re good with the MAP wording I’ll sign off and route to Vivek for final approval. Also, please send the endpoint list you mentioned ASAP.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-11-30T08:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Overnight coverage request ahead of data-migration

Approved with conditions:

- Temporary SLA window approved for 22:00 PST Dec 4 — 10:00 PST Dec 5: P1 initial response = 60 minutes, P2 initial response = 3 hours.
- One-time credit: 5% pro-rated for the billing month if a P1 incident meets our incident criteria and is attributable to the migration.
- Redwood requires: (1) completed MAP uploaded to our Drive, (2) a brief (15m) pre-migration sync the day prior, (3) a post-window incident review within 3 business days.

Ben — assign primary on-call and add the bridge dial-in to the MAP. Vanessa — please send a formal confirmation to James and include the MAP and runbook.

-Vivek

Date: 2027-12-01T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dec 4-5 temporary overnight support bridge & MAP

James — thanks again. This is a confirmation note with the finalized items: 

1) Bridge window: 22:00 PST Dec 4 — 10:00 PST Dec 5. Zoom bridge details and phone dial-in are in the attached MAP.
2) SLA carve-out: P1 initial response = 60 minutes; P2 initial response = 3 hours for the window only.
3) Credit: 5% pro-rated for the billing month if a P1 incident is validated as migration-attributable.
4) On-call: Ben Carter (primary), Laura Bennett (secondary). Ben will be on the bridge; Laura will be available for escalations.
5) Pre-migration sync: 15-minute call on Dec 3 at 14:00 PST to confirm endpoints and throttles.
6) Post-window review: within 3 business days.

Attached: CLEARSTREAM_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx, overnight-bridge-runbook.md (includes thresholds, runbook steps, and dial-ins). Please confirm the endpoint list and accept the MAP so we can finalize access.

Looking forward to a smooth migration — we’ll be on standby.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
